highlights: code-package now screens its brief and claimed files before any claim or model call; --dry-run shows which models, files and checks a package would use without spending anything; zodchi flow close, cancel, runs, wait and verify end, follow and check runs without a model step.

Agents get JSON errors with ZODCHI_AGENT=1, exit 3 for sign-in, and zodchi --usage; local Codex steps can spend ChatGPT credits with "credits": true in ~/.zodchi/flow.json, and flow status shows what each step spent.
The workflow engine and each workflow are separate crates, so a change to one workflow rebuilds only that workflow, and CI runs the scenarios of the changed area.
